title: Opioid overdose
version: Healthify 'Naloxone for opioid overdose' (reviewed 18 Dec 2025 by a Health NZ | Te Whatu Ora Waitematā pharmacist, updated 25 Mar 2026); Community Alcohol and Drug Services 'Naloxone Emergency Kit' pamphlet v7 (April 2026, on Healthify); Healthify 'Opioid overdose' (reviewed 8 Feb 2022, updated 25 Mar 2025); The Level (NZ Drug Foundation) 'How to use injectable naloxone' (27 Jul 2022) and 'How to use Nyxoid...' (14 Sep 2021); Medsafe Nyxoid CMI (May 2019); AUSTRALIAN: NSW Health Prenoxad consumer sheet (26 Jul 2023), health.gov.au 'How to administer naloxone' (no date); all read 21 Nov 2026
sourceNote: Direct download refused (proxy blocks healthify.nz and medsafe.govt.nz PDFs) and web search gave titles only, so every line was read by a fetch tool asked to quote exact lines in short pieces (rejoined). No PDF was in sources/. Sections: A Healthify naloxone page (main: only injectable naloxone in NZ, nasal spray unavailable; call 111, stay, recovery position, note time, second dose if no response in 2 to 5 minutes, rescue breathing 2 breaths every 5 seconds, lasts 20 / 20 to 90 minutes, side effects). B NZ kit pamphlet April 2026 (8 numbered steps, put back in number order because the PDF text was scrambled; kit contents 5 x 1ml Naloxone 0.4mg ampoules; signs; risks; storage below 25°C). C Healthify opioid overdose page (signs, while waiting for help, stay on phone with 111). D The Level injectable steps (10 steps, wait 2-3 minutes, repeat after 3 minutes, no maximum dose, CPR if you know how). E The Level Nyxoid steps (2021; says Nyxoid not available in NZ). F Medsafe Nyxoid CMI (1.8 mg per spray, repeat every 2-3 minutes, recovery position; partial). G, H AUSTRALIAN (000): NSW Prenoxad sheet (0.4 ml to first black line, every 2 to 3 minutes, rescue breathing steps, recovery position steps, hand syringe to ambulance crew, lasts 30-90 minutes); health.gov.au (lasts about 30 to 90 minutes). Not captured: Healthify list of where to get kits and links to guides; pamphlet 'see below' injection instructions and maybe more signs; most of the Nyxoid CMI (exact step numbering, spray method); one Healthify line ('An overdose is always an emergency...') unconfirmed. Differences: wait before repeat dose 2 to 5 min (A), 3-5 min (B), 2-3 min / after 3 min (D), 2-3 min (E, F, G); number of doses: A and B describe a second dose only, D, E, F, G repeat until help arrives / no maximum; how long naloxone lasts 20 minutes (A4, B), 20 to 90 minutes (A5), 30-90 / about 30 to 90 minutes (G, H); rescue breathing: A after the second dose if not breathing, B if not breathing (step 6, after first dose), C only if 111 asks, D/G CPR if you know how; recovery position before naloxone (A, B) vs after (E, F, G); The Level injectable steps omit recovery position. Gaps: NZ sources give no rescue-breathing technique beyond '2 breaths every 5 seconds', no CPR rate, no exact injection dose instruction (whole 1ml ampoule implied, not stated), and what to tell paramedics is only the time(s) naloxone was given (D2 step 1: tell 111 that you think it is an overdose and you have naloxone); no St John NZ or Health NZ own page on opioid overdose was found; highalert.org.nz was blocked by bot protection.
status: Reviewer: 3 instructions missed and 15 findings, all fixed; NZ sources differ on the wait (2 to 5, 3-5, 2-3 min). 118 of 118 quotes exact (web copy).
